answer_2.quote: In accordance with previously established methodologies, we employ three distinct metrics: Fréchet Gesture Distance (FGD), Beat Consistency Score (BC), and Diversity.

answer_4.quote: A user study was conducted ... 28 respondents ... participants were asked to assess three distinct facets of the generated movements: Naturalness; Smoothness; Synchrony between speech and generated gestures.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated Naturalness, Smoothness, and Synchrony on a 1-5 Likert scale.
